title: Gateway compatibility sieve and engagement SLAs for private deploy requests
creator: Asha Patel
description: Create a lightweight, repeatable intake "sieve" (categorization flow) and corresponding engagement SLAs for incoming Private/VPC/on‑prem deployment requests where networking limitations (air‑gapped, proxy constraints, restricted egress, nonstandard gateways) or upgrade blockers are present. Deliverables: a scoring rubric, required customer artifact checklist, triage routing actions (self‑serve lane, concierge lane, escalation lane), sample email templates, and an operations playbook for SE/PM triage. This ticket focuses on non-bug requests (feature/compatibility/ops) that require network gating decisions.
background: We receive many enterprise intake requests that vary in network constraints and readiness. Current process is ad hoc: some requests sit in triage for days, others move to engineering prematurely causing rework. Recent audits (see links) show inconsistent SLAs and missing customer artifacts. Objective: reduce time-to-decision, avoid engineering churn, and surface high-risk network constraints earlier in the funnel.
triage_rubric: Score 0-10 across three axes: Network Complexity (0=public cloud-friendly, 10=air-gapped with custom gateway), Upgrade Risk (0=stateless short-lived infra, 10=tenant with strict change freeze), Data Sensitivity (none/low/medium/high mapped to 0/3/7/10).

Routing thresholds: 0-6 -> Self-Serve lane (template-based onboarding + standard docs); 7-12 -> Concierge lane (SE-led 5-business-day assessment); 13-20 -> Escalation lane (PM + Eng + Security intake, targeted kickoff within 48 hours).
Weighting: Network Complexity 50%, Upgrade Risk 30%, Data Sensitivity 20%.
Automated pre-check: customer must complete a 12-question network probe form; missing answers auto-route to Self-Serve hold with clear instructions.
engagement_slas: Acknowledgement: <48 hours from submission (automated email + initial score).
Self-Serve lane: Decision or clear next steps within 7 calendar days; template playbooks and readiness checker provided.
Concierge lane: Dedicated SE assigned; complete network assessment and risk summary within 5 business days of assignment.
Escalation lane: PM + Eng + Sec kickoff scheduled within 48 hours; draft mitigation plan and timeline within 10 business days.
required_customer_artifacts: Network topology diagram (logical), including gateway/proxy/firewall zones and NAT details.
Egress whitelist policy (if applicable) and any approved external endpoints list.
Upgrade window constraints and maintenance freeze calendar (next 90 days).
TLS/KMS/HSM details for key management and any required compliance attestations.
On‑prem operator contact and support escalation path.
routing_actions: Automated scoring email: includes score, lane, and a tailored checklist link.
Self-Serve: provide runbook + readiness checker and optional pre-configured edge connector artifact.
Concierge: create dedicated tracker (private GH issue) and schedule 1:1 network screenshare; SE to produce short assessment doc.
Escalation: create cross-functional incident-style ticket; include security checklist and designate owner.
acceptance_criteria: Published public-facing intake page and automated questionnaire linked from Sales/Support templates.
Internal playbook (Confluence) with decision tree, scoring calculator (spreadsheet), and sample templates for each lane.
SE-run onboarding checklist and a minimum viable 'edge connector' artifact for common proxy patterns.
Measured baseline: reduce avg triage time for network-constrained requests from current baseline by 40% within first quarter after launch.
success_metrics: Median time to initial decision (target <48 hours).
% of requests that have complete artifact set at first touch (target 70%).
Engineering rework rate caused by missing network info (target reduction by 50%).
Customer satisfaction score for onboarding experience (post-onboarding survey) target >4.0/5.0.
